| description = Boats are listed here because they are movable objects, even though they're not controlled by the environment. They are small wooden canoes that can be driven by player.

To use a boat, simply get in it and right-click on the boat: you will receive a message that you have control. Boats are very slow but are affected by current movement speed buffs such as [[Spirit of Wolf]]. Boats are notoriously buggy however, so use them at your own risk.

It is possible to beg from a boat. Although it will never give coin, this can be used to train [[Begging]].
